description: What the Mockup Director main window may call besides the app's own commands: events (listen for files-opened and for the window's close request), the default window queries, dragging the window by the toolbar (data-tauri-drag-region, double-click maximizes), the window title (the active tab's name), closing the window after saving the session (onCloseRequested destroys it), the native save dialog, and the devtools shortcut in builds run from source (Tauri compiles that command into debug builds only).
